The live data journey

Working pipeline

From scattered
pages to one index.

A source-aware FastAPI service normalizes permitted listings into SQLite, then serves this interface and its map view.

Source-specific adapters check permitted pages on a schedule, with visible attribution and a direct path back to the original listing.

Addresses, property types and price bases are normalized without erasing source identity. Cross-source duplicate matching is planned after enough refresh history is available.

A compact read-only API sends the newest version of each property to this interface, along with freshness and source metadata.
